complaints.title: Deep Hazardous Pothole near 100ft Road Junction
complaints.description: Large crater-sized pothole spanning approximately 1.5 meters across the left vehicular lane. Causing severe traffic congestion and poses serious safety risk to two-wheelers.

complaints.title: Non-Functional Streetlights in Residential Block 4
complaints.description: A stretch of 6 consecutive streetlamps has been unlit for the past 4 nights. Road is completely dark creating security concerns for walking residents.

complaints.title: Overflowing Municipal Dumpster near Public School
complaints.description: Refuse has overflowed onto the pedestrian pavement outside St. Mary’s school gate. Emitting strong foul odor and attracting stray cattle.

complaints.title: Freshwater Main Pipe Burst and Submersion
complaints.description: Underground potable water conduit burst creating geyser and flooding road corner. Drinking water wasted continuously for over 6 hours.

complaints.title: Vandalized Children Swing and Park Benches

statusHistory.description: Complaint registered by citizen with geolocation tag.
Triage officer inspected photographic evidence and verified road damage.
Assigned to Roads & Infrastructure field team; asphalt mix dispatched.
Pipeline welding completed, water pressure normalized and road re-tarred.
Excavation team on-site with asphalt paving vehicles.
Official resolution recorded: Road excavation completed, base stone compacted, and hot-mix asphalt surface paved smoothly.

resolutionRecords.resolutionDescription: Municipal water maintenance division excavated damaged pipe section, replaced 4m ductile iron pipeline, and completed high-pressure weld sealing. Road restored.
Road excavation completed, base stone compacted, and hot-mix asphalt surface paved smoothly.

feedbacks.comments: Prompt response from the water board team within 24 hours of reporting!
